decision: The competitor (Atlassian Williams F1 Team) is fined €5,000
fact: Car 23 started the formation lap with parts of a tyre blanket still on the car.
offence: Breach of Article B5.5.5.a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. When Car 23 was released from its jacks before the start of the formation lap parts of the right front tyre blanket got caught under the car. Although the team tried to remove the parts before the start of the formation lap, these attempts were unsuccessful and car left with a cable still hanging off the car and the team thereby did not take all of their equipment with them after the 15 second signal.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Start Procedure Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
